items.title: Stubborn Belly Fat Starts In Your Liver (Here's The Fix)
items.summary: Visit https://loveyourliver.com and use code DAVE7 to access the special offer from de-liver-ance mentioned in this episode. Fatty Liver, GLP-1s, Alcohol, Hormones, Brain Fog, Weight Gain & Longevity Host Dave Asprey sits down with Siggi Clavien, Founder and CEO of The Liver Clinic and de-liver-ance, to explore why the liver may be one of the most overlooked organs in metabolism, hormone health, detoxification, brain function, weight management, and longevity. Siggi explains why fatty liver can develop without obvious symptoms and why someone can appear lean and healthy while still have significant liver fat. Drawing on thousands of liver scans, he shares what his team has observed in people whose blood markers appeared normal despite signs of fatty liver on imaging, and explains how tools such as FibroScan can reveal liver fat, stiffness, and fibrosis. Dave and Siggi go deep into triglycerides, cholesterol, insulin resistance, brain fog, weight gain, bile production, thyroid hormone activation, testosterone, estrogen metabolism, and liver regeneration. They also explore how alcohol, environmental chemicals, plastics, processed foods, artificial sweeteners, medications, and other exposures may place additional stress on the liver. The conversation also tackles rapid weight loss and GLP-1 medications, including Siggi’s concerns about compounds released from fat tissue during aggressive weight loss and why protecting muscle, eating enough protein, and supporting liver function…

items.title: They Lab Tested Retatrutide — The Results Were Shocking
items.summary: Are you actually getting the peptide you paid for? In this Peptide A to Z investigation, we look at independent laboratory testing of peptide products labeled Retatrutide and NAD+ that were purchased over the counter from a Brooklyn smoke shop. Four sealed vials were tested. Two were labeled Retatrutide 10mg. Two were labeled NAD+ 500mg. 🧬 FREE PEPTIDE GUIDE: Get the Peptide A to Z Guide and learn the basics of peptides, research, terminology, and more: PeptideAtoZ.com 👥 JOIN THE PEPTIDE A TO Z COMMUNITY: Connect with others interested in peptide research, longevity, and the latest peptide science: PeptideAtoZ.com According to the reported laboratory results, none of the four samples could be positively identified as the substance stated on the label. The retatrutide samples also produced an unexpected signal that the laboratory described as suggesting “extreme contamination.” But the story gets even more concerning. CBS News separately investigated a certificate of analysis associated with the retatrutide product. The laboratory named on that certificate reportedly told CBS that it never issued the certificate and had never had the company as a client. In this video, we break down: What the independent testing actually found Why peptide identity, purity, quantity, and sterility are different What a Certificate of Analysis, or COA, actually tells you Why a QR code doesn't automatically prove a peptide was independently tested The difference between research peptides and…

items.title: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. My whole life doctors told me I'd need open heart surgery in my…

items.title: Top 3 Things To Improve Your Health
items.summary: Ep. 1,010: Join us as we sit down with Dr. William Li – an internationally renowned physician, scientist, and New York Times bestselling Author. His groundbreaking research has led to the development of more than 40 new medical treatments that impact care for more than 70 diseases including diabetes, blindness, heart disease and obesity. In this episode, Dr. William Li breaks down what actually happens inside the body when it comes to aging, disease, and cancer – and how much power we have through the choices we make every day. We dive into the foods that can support your body’s natural defenses, the everyday exposures that may be working against you, and the simple habits that can have a major impact on your health. Dr. Li also shares his approach to eating for longevity without fear or restriction, why gut health is so central to overall health, and the surprising role everyday beverages and pantry staples can play in your routine.
